scene_description: Wooden table with a closed silver laptop at the front-left and an open brown box at the front-right. A brown Data Structures book lies farther back behind the laptop. Front is the open table edge; left and right are as seen facing it.

targets.name: silver laptop
targets.description: Closed silver Apple laptop with a blue sticker lying at the front-left, in front of the brown book and left of the box.
targets.clearance_notes: Top and side edges are exposed, with open table around it.

targets.name: brown box
targets.description: Open brown cardboard box holding small loose items, standing near the front-right of the table, to the right of the laptop.
targets.clearance_notes: Sides are exposed beneath the open flaps, with no overhead obstruction.
targets.other_notes: Dimensions describe the box body, excluding the unfolded flaps.

targets.name: brown Data Structures book
targets.description: Brown Schaum's 'Data Structures' paperback lying behind the silver laptop, toward the back-right of the arrangement.
targets.clearance_notes: Top and sides are exposed, but the laptop occupies the direct approach from the front.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the book to an open area near the front edge, clear of the laptop.
